newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela Congress approves extra gov't spending.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela Congress approves extra gov't spending.

text.p: Venezuelan legislators approved Wednesday a government request for 294.218 billion bolivars ($611 million) in unbudgeted spending.
The 13 spending plans approved by Congress would be backed by higher-than-expected tax revenues and windfall oil revenues during the first quarter of the year, legislators said.
The government's 1997 budget forecast an average oil export price of $14.50 per barrel, but prices have averaged $17.66 per barrel for the year so far.
The spending would be used for a variety of projects and shortfalls, legislators said.
